title: tidy_build_synced
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.13) — shape from tidy-prd.md §7 tidy_buildSynced, FR-22, FR-23, §8; not routed yet. Upstream: adobe/tools/tidy/_upstream/jsx/host.jsx:251 TIDY.buildSynced (entry tidy_buildSynced :313). CEP WNC_TIDY.buildSynced (signed bridge). Contract keys are snake_case; the port translates the upstream camelCase keys (docs/adobe/phase-6b-reservations.md). Podcast sync: a new sequence from the first clip (its settings), emptied, tracks added through QE addTracks and re-read, Cam n on its video track, the mics on the audio tracks after the last one the camera sound uses, every placement read back within one frame and mismatches reported; existing sequences untouched. UXP cannot add audio tracks (T3b red), so uxp is false.

bin.description: bin path to create it in; optional, default '06 Sequences' (host.jsx:256)

first.description: nodeId of the clip whose settings the sequence takes (Cam 1's longest clip); optional, default cams[0] else mics[0] (host.jsx:254)

start.description: placement, sequence seconds (the earliest clip starts at 0, FR-22)

track.description: track index, 0-based (Premiere's DOM order; upstream error messages say V<index + 1>)

data.description: {name,bin?,first?,cams?,mics?}: at least one cam or mic, else 'Nothing to place'.

video_tracks.description: video tracks in the new sequence (upstream `videoTracks`)

audio_tracks.description: audio tracks in the new sequence (upstream `audioTracks`)

mic_track.description: the first mic track, 1-based (upstream `micTrack` = used + 2, host.jsx:293), i.e. A<mic_track>

readback.description: {placed,sequence,video_tracks,audio_tracks,mic_track,problems}. The object stays open: keys the host adds are not rejected.
